expect: €3,300 – €3,400 gross per month, including 14.4% shift allowance; €0.23 per kilometre travel allowance; 25 vacation days + 13 ADV days, already financially included in the salary; STIPP pension; a long-term position; possibility of being taken over by the client after 1,040 hours, approximately 6 months full-time; possibility to obtain an EPT or reach truck certificate through Wiertz Company or the client; working in an international high-tech logistics environment; a close-knit team of 10–15 colleagues.
